description: TACKLE COMMITMENT 4 - SLIDING. Two numbers in the slide chain 0x1441a96f0 -> 0x1441aa1d0 -> 0x1441a97d0. (a) the per-player lookahead window N = 4 + trunc(4*(Aggression-40)/80): lowering the floor to 30 gives mid-aggression defenders (70-79 Aggression) one more frame of window, i.e. they start committing where only 80+ players did. EMULATED: stock {40:4,60:5,70:5,80:6,90:6,99:6} -> {40:4,60:5,70:6,80:6,90:7,99:7}. (b) the slide distance gate 4.0 + 0.8*risk metres -> 4.5 + 0.8*risk. Sliding is already gated on ball height <= 0.5 m, a 90 deg facing cone and a swept-capsule test against 11 players, so this is not a licence to lunge.
